meaning: An explicit family of interpretations has a necessary being in its designated actual member while neither its existence nor its nonexistence is known across all epistemically available interpretations. An analyst’s model/consequence test; no result proves Kantian idealism, real possibility, premise truth or a refutation of God. See docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md. The revised conclusion explicitly requires universal accessibility of every metaphysical frame.
